messages:
jamie: FYI — scheduling a BIOS microcode patch for az24 GPU racks next Tue 02:00-04:00 UTC. Plan is a rolling patch w/ thermal probe checks and tenant-safe evacuations. Expect 5–8% capacity delta briefly during drains.

jamie: Scope — ~24 nodes (gpu-pool-az24-*), firmware bump that addresses a thermal erratum. We'll cordon -> drain -> reboot -> validation -> uncordon per-node. Trying to avoid mass cold cache loss.

jamie: Impacts: best-effort no-downtime for Hosted, but Dedicated pools will see evictions for affected nodes. Quick SLO notes in runbook below.

ops-bot: Automated checklist attached: patch runbook + preflight checks. (see /ops runbook id=patch-az24-2026-03) :gear:

alex: how many concurrent nodes will be evicted? do we have buffer in az24 right now?

jamie: @alex planning 2 nodes at a time. Current free capacity (pre-reserve) is ~12% in az24 but some tenants pinned to dedicated racks. We'll exclude priority-tenant racks from the roll.

mira: Recommend we pre-warm KV cache on standby nodes after each reboot to avoid token-cost spike from regen. Can add a kv-seed step to the runbook.

sam: +1 on kv-seed. Also propose staggering start by AZ-local traffic low window: start 02:15 UTC to give a 15m buffer for late-night backfills.

tc: Customer comms — enterprise customers on Dedicated: send targeted notice (SLA impact window) 48h before. Also open support ticket template for any forced reconnects. I'll sync with success.

jamie: Good call @tc. I'll draft a short blurb.

alex: Quick ask: any known regression risk with this microcode for our A100 variant? Who validated?

jamie: This patch was validated on a 3-node canary cluster last week (results: thermal delta <2C, no perf regression on perf-suite v2). Still flagged as mildly risky for older fan firmware; we'll run a fan-speed sanity probe post-boot.

mira: Add post-boot perf check: run perf-suite --smoke --latency and an inference micro-benchmark sampling 3 models (gpt-small, embed-128, rerank). Fail criteria: p99 token latency increase >10% or memory regressions.

ops-bot: Canary results summary: PASS (3/3) for microcode v1.2.8 on lab-nodes. Failure thresholds not exceeded.

sam: Runbook snippet (for ops):
```
# drain + reboot sequence
kubectl cordon node/$NODE
kubectl drain node/$NODE --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force --grace-period=120
ssh root@$NODE 'fw_update --apply /var/patches/bios_v1.2.8 && reboot'
# wait for node online, run thermal_probe.sh, then uncordon
```

jamie: We'll also enable temporary routing fallback: any request failing short-circuit to next-best compatible model/region for hosted. Config pushed to routing-policy staging.

alex: Cost note — draining will cause some burst VM reinstates and cache misses; estimate +$800 for the window if run at full scale. Can we cap concurrency lower to trim cost?

jamie: If we drop to 1 node at a time we cut cost estimate ~40% but stretch window ~2x. Prefer 2 at a time unless customers object.

tc: I'll summarize options in the customer note. Default will be 2 at a time; include opt-out for critical tenants.

mira: ops validation checklist addition: after uncordon, run:
- kv-seed warmup (10m)
- perf-suite smoke (5m)
- telemetry check for fan/temps (10m)
If any step fails, we mark node isolated and rollback to prior image.

jamie: rollback path: if thermal instability or perf regressions > threshold, we will reimage node to previous BIOS and restart patch window after remediation. Escalate to firmware team.

ops-bot: Scheduling note: tentative timeline created. Running patch in cohorts: cohort-1 (nodes 01–08) start 02:15 UTC, cohort-2 (09–16) start 03:00 UTC, cohort-3 (17–24) start 03:45 UTC. Total window target 02:15–05:30 UTC.

sam: Can we hold 2 warm standby nodes with kvcache pre-seeded to absorb traffic spikes? I can provision if approvals ok.

jamie: Yes provision. Mark them standby-az24-warm-01/02 and exclude from tenant pinned sets.

alex: One more — network team: will this touch NIC microcode? Any risk of net flaps?

jamie: No NIC microcode in this patch. Still, we'll monitor egress queue for 10m after each node rejoins. ops-bot will run net-checks.

tc: I'll open the customer notices and link to this thread. Also flag support to expect possible reconnect tickets during 02:15–05:30 UTC.

mira: LGTM from infra validation perspective.

sam: :thumbsup: I'll queue orchestration and kv pre-seed.

jamie: Thanks all — finalizing runbook and will post updated link in the channel 24h before. If anyone wants to opt a tenant out, ping me.

ops-bot: Recorded runbook version: patch-az24-2026-03-v1.1 (link: https://ops.internal/runbooks/patch-az24-2026-03)

tc: noted. :white_check_mark:

jamie: End of thread.
